getShed.name: The Shed
getShed.strap: A street's worth of tools in one lock-up

listTools.name: Hedge trimmer
listTools.note: Two batteries, both charged. Bring it back oiled.

listTools.name: Pressure washer
listTools.note: The lance sticks. Twist it, do not pull it.

listTools.name: Cordless drill
listTools.note: The bits are in the lid. Count them back in.

listTools.name: Stand mixer
listTools.note: The dough hook lives in the bowl.

listTools.name: Pasta machine
listTools.note: Never wash it. Brush it out.

listTools.name: Projector
listTools.note: HDMI only. Bring your own cable.
